entry.title: πAMB 0.1.0
entry.summary: # πAMB 0.1.0 — First release A generative ambient garden for Akai Force / MPC: port of **[AMB-1](https://github.com/charlesvestal/fm1-amb)** by **Charles Vestal** (M-VAVE FM-1), after *Music for Airports*. - **Engine**: AMB-1 unchanged — pad (Rhodes or Voices), bells on four tape loops of unequal length, gliding bass, soft Euclidean pulse, one scale and one slowly drifting chord, tape echo and Dattorro plate reverb. - **Eight pieces** as native presets: Garden, Departures, Voices, Afternoon, Nig
